text: To be, or not to be, that is the question.
All that glitters is not gold.
source: Shakespeare, The Merchant of Venice (proverbial form)

text: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.
source: Dickens, A Tale of Two Cities

text: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.
A penny saved is a penny earned.
The early bird catches the worm.

source: Robert Browning / Mies van der Rohe

text: Where there's a will, there's a way.
Rome wasn't built in a day.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Ask not what your country can do for you; ask what you can do for your country.
The only thing we have to fear is fear itself.
That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.
Frankly, my dear, I don't give a damn.
May the Force be with you.
Not all those who wander are lost.
source: Tolkien, The Fellowship of the Ring

text: The pen is mightier than the sword.

source: Whole Earth Catalog, 1974 (popularised by Steve Jobs)

text: Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee.
Life is like a box of chocolates.

source: A Game of Thrones, George R. R. Martin

text: The lady doth protest too much, methinks.
Brevity is the soul of wit.
